frontier_results.statement: Quasi-linear transported carrier retains the exact rank-one P/K line, the quarter-shift D8 recurrence, and the certified full-E8 spectrum ledger.
Each mixed D8 pair carries the same rapidity transport as P/K, shifted by one quarter; these are the reciprocal pairs whose opposite grades source the D curvature.
Pure Lorentz/D algebraic wedge terms annihilate the symmetric co-soldering subspace; they cannot by themselves give a Hessian to f_(mu nu).
The pair (T_w,D) has the desired residual Spin(10)xSpin(3,1) stabilizer at representation level, but the action has not yet selected/activated the orbit.
The representation-admissible PhiBB invariant exists, but its microscopic coupling is not derived.
Full-adjoint BF/BB matrices have not yet been exported for the matched-kernel test.
Full D8/BRST constraint Jacobian on f_(mu nu) has not been supplied.
No linearized BRST/constraint complex on the ten symmetric co-soldering components has been exported.
No independently varied candidate coframe matrix has been supplied.

Neutral principal-symbol uniqueness is already certified by T_w. Action-level one-spin-2 closure additionally requires the symmetric co-soldering constraint/BRST test to leave no independent f_(mu nu) mode.
Full constrained quadratic Hessian and/or constraint map has not been supplied.
Absolute mirror selection and physical cosmology remain downstream of A0-A5.
